name: Shoyu or Chicken Paitan Ramen (Gut-Safe Custom Order)
whyItWorks: Refined wheat alkaline noodles + rich broth + marinated soft-boiled egg (Ajitama) + tender braised pork belly (Chashu).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Shoyu or Chicken Paitan broth over heavy Tonkotsu if fat triggers transit. Hold the wood ear mushrooms (kikurage), corn kernels, raw scallions, and chili oil.
